mailboxId.description: Short opaque identifier returned by outlook.list_mailboxes.v1.

query.description: Natural-language or keyword query. The sidecar may expand it into additional local search terms.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return. Defaults to 10.

includeAttachments.description: Also match against attachment file names and locally extractable attachment text. Defaults to true.

summarize.description: Produce a locally generated plain-text summary of the hits when a local model is configured. Defaults to true.
